_comment: Editable rules mapping Simyo document titles to filename summaries. Simyo is a Dutch provider, so the titles are Dutch: 'factuur' is an invoice and 'specificatie' is the per-call usage breakdown. The categories they map to (Statement, Tax Document) stay in the project's own vocabulary so filing matches the other apps. Simyo issues no tax forms; tax_rules is empty on purpose. Repair after running diagnose.command against your real Facturen page.
